context: A police officer briefs a uni reporter about a complex case
purpose: Teach: 暗殺/強盗/誘拐/人質/テロリスト/右翼/左翼/慶

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、暗殺未遂と当初報じられましたが、強盗事件と判明しました。
lines.en: This case was initially reported as an assassination attempt, but it's been confirmed as a robbery.
lines.style: Level, professional opening. Measured pace. Clear separation between the first clause and the correction — not rushed. Clinical but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 誘拐疑いも一時持たれた、と聞きました。
lines.en: I heard kidnapping was suspected at one point.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity — leaning forward slightly in the voice. Soft interrogative lilt. Not accusatory, just asking to understand the timeline.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。一時、人質を取った可能性が議論されていました。
lines.en: Yes. For a brief period, the possibility of hostage-taking was being discussed.
lines.style: Measured confirmation. Slight emphasis on 「一時」 — the temporal limitation. Steady eye contact level. Professional distance maintained.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 当時の極右、右翼系の集会との関連も噂されてましたよね。
lines.en: And there were rumors connecting it to far-right rallies and extremist gatherings at that time, weren't there?
lines.style: Probing but respectful. Slight lift at the end — inviting confirmation, not challenging. Patient. Ren testing the officer's openness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察は、テロリストの関与を否定しています。
lines.en: The police have ruled out any involvement by terrorist organizations.
lines.style: Firmer statement. Slight weight on 「否定」. Official language carrying its own authority. Not defensive, but closing that particular line.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 左翼系団体への調査も、進められましたか。
lines.en: Did investigations also proceed into left-wing groups in parallel?
lines.style: Calm, methodical question. No edge. Ren following the logic of inquiry — if one side, then the other. Respectful symmetry in the asking.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 並行して、慶應大の研究者からも、社会学的所見を頂きました。
lines.en: In parallel, we also consulted with researchers from Keio University who offered sociological perspectives on the matter.
lines.style: Closing statement with slight expansion. Adds dimension — the intellectual apparatus brought to bear. Measured pace, deliberate. Feels like a thoughtful conclusion.
